title: Juicy Shattering Australian Turnips Galette
description: A rich and festive Australian dish featuring turnips, spherified for a unique texture and experience. High-protein ingredients make this dish suitable for fitness enthusiasts and athletes.

ingredients.name: Turnips
ingredients.notes: Choose small to medium-sized turnips for the best results

ingredients.name: Caster Sugar
ingredients.notes: To balance acidity and add sweetness

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: To balance acidity and add brightness

instructions: Begin by peeling and chopping the turnips into small cubes. Set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the sodium alginate, sugar, and a pinch of salt. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and a splash of water until smooth.
Add the chopped turnips to the egg yolk mixture and mix until well combined.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the turnip mixture and cook until lightly browned.
Sprinkle the sugar-alginate mixture over the top of the turnip mixture and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the turnip mixture into a bowl of cold water. Allow the spherification process to occur for 5-7 minutes.
Once the spherified turnips have formed, remove them from the water with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In a small saucepan, melt the Australian salted butter over low heat. Add the parsley and lemon juice, stirring to combine.
To assemble the galette, place a portion of the spherified turnips on a plate, followed by a dollop of the parsley-butter sauce.
